faq.q: How quickly can I be seen?
faq.a: Members are seen the same or next business day when something comes up. Routine visits are scheduled at a time that suits you.

faq.q: Can I reach Dr. Shtern after hours?
faq.a: Yes. Members have phone access to the practice 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. In an emergency, always call 911 first.

faq.q: Does Medicare pay the membership fee?
faq.a: No. Medicare does not cover concierge fees. Covered services at your visits are billed to Medicare as usual.

faq.q: Are labs done in the office?
faq.a: Yes. Blood is drawn in the office, and ECGs, stool occult blood tests and rapid flu, COVID-19 and strep tests are done here too.

faq.q: What happens if I need a specialist?
faq.a: Dr. Shtern chooses the specialist, contacts them, and follows up on what they find, so your care stays in one place.

faq.q: Which hospitals does Dr. Shtern use?
faq.a: She has privileges at Jupiter Medical Center and Palm Beach Gardens Medical Center.

faq.q: Do you treat kidney disease and high blood pressure?
faq.a: Yes. Dr. Shtern is board-certified in nephrology as well as internal medicine. See kidney care and hypertension.
